🎓 How to Use the Pricing Rationale Skill

Generate complete ROI analyses, business cases, and executive presentations.

💬

Trigger Phrases

  • "Calculate ROI for..."
  • "Build a business case for..."
  • "Value justification for..."
  • "TCO comparison..."
📝

Sample Prompt

"Build a business case for SAP S/4HANA Cloud for a $5B manufacturing company. Include ROI, payback period, and executive summary."
📊

What You'll Get

  • Executive Summary — CFO-ready overview
  • ROI Analysis — Full calculations
  • Risk Assessment — Sensitivity analysis
  • Competitive Comparison — Alternative costs
💡

Pro Tips

  • Include industry — Benchmarks vary
  • Mention deal size — Scales analysis
  • Ask for objections — "What would CFO push back on?"
